ranking_method: Three lexicographic research-priority scenarios within biological follow-up lanes

protein_first.description: Qualifying protein enrichment first; then normal-tissue review status; then conservative RNA effect size

normal_review_first.description: Normal-tissue expression review first; then qualifying protein evidence; then conservative RNA effect size

rna_discovery_first.description: Conservative RNA enrichment first; then Tier A detection breadth; then protein and normal-tissue context

rna_metric: Minimum of baseline and QC-screened tumor-vs-normal log2 fold changes
rna_independence_note: Baseline and QC-screened analyses are related sensitivity analyses, not independent experiments
protein_policy: Qualifying enrichment treated as supporting evidence; absence of qualifying enrichment is not interpreted as absent protein
normal_tissue_policy: Missing IHC data assigned a distinct unassessed category, never a favorable selectivity classification
normal_review_order_interpretation: Scenario-specific annotation-review priority; not a quantitative clinical toxicity estimate
dependency_policy: DepMap CRISPR gene effects retained as context but not used to determine antibody-antigen prioritization
stable_followup_rule: Within the same lane, appears in the top 20 under at least two of three scenarios
limitations: The research-priority ordering depends on selected evidence hierarchy assumptions.
A high ranking does not imply a clinically favorable therapeutic window.
Normal-tissue IHC measurements are not direct toxicity assessments.
Missing normal-tissue IHC evidence does not imply low expression.
Bulk tumor RNA and proteomics do not establish malignant-cell origin.
CPTAC enrichment is exploratory and based on measured protein coverage.
GPI anchoring and extracellular topology do not establish antibody accessibility.
CRISPR dependency is not required for antibody-drug conjugate targeting.
The DepMap colorectal cohort has not been confirmed MSS.
TCGA Tier B is computationally low-MSI rather than independently confirmed MSS.
No target has been experimentally validated.
